title: 'Jellyfish' probe the radar beam and are seen flying in a pair
summary: Skywatcher tells of 'Jellyfish' probe the radar beam and are seen flying in a pair, about February (c. 2025) at Skywatcher site, about 6 km to the north and south, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Skywatcher site, about 6 km to the north and south

tellings.quote: received, and then in in February for the first time saw how two " "Jellyfish" fly together on the radar

plain: Skywatcher, a small company that says it tries to call up UFOs, says it tracks objects it nicknames "jellyfish" with radar at its field site. In February 2025, the group says, it saw two jellyfish flying together on the radar for the first time, about 6 kilometres to the north and south, and the objects seemed to probe the radar beam. If true, it would suggest the objects notice and react to being watched.
